sentences.text: By way of filing the instant appeal, a challenge is made to the order framing charges dated 29.07.2024 passed by the learned Special Judge SC/ST (POA) Cases Bhilwara.
There is a defect that the appeal is barred by limitation of 68 days and no application under Section 5 of the Limitation Act is furnished along with the appeal.

Besides the above when had a cursory look over the merits of the case, it is observed that sufficient material was available on record to frame charges against the appellant for offence under Sections 342 and 354 of IPC and under the penal provision of SC/ST Act.
The learned trial Judge has made discussion of the legal and factual aspects of the matter and already exonerated the appellant from offence under Section 376 read with 511 of IPC.
I see no reason to interfere in a well reasoned order.
Accordingly, the instant appeal is dismissed.

(FARJAND ALI),J 81-divya/-
